sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XII OF 2003
ORDINANCE XII OF
2003
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE PUBLIC SERVICE
COMMISSION
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2003
An Ordinance
further to amend the North-West Frontier Province
Public Service
Commission Ordinance, 1978
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 13th October, 2003]
No.LEGIS.I(20)/73/6069, dated
13-10-2003.-----The following Ordinance by the Governor of the North-West
Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.------(1) This Ordinance may be called the North-West Frontier
Province Public Service Commission (Amendment) Ordinance, 2003.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
